#include <iostream>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <set>
#include <map>

#include <string>

#include <random>
#define REP(i,a,n) for(int i=a;i<=n;++i)
#define PER(i,a,n) for(int i=n;i>=a;--i)
#define hr std::cout << std::endl
#define pb std::vector<int>::push_back
#define lc (o<<1)
#define rc (lc|1)
#define mid ((l+r)>>1)
#define ls lc,l,mid
#define rs rc,mid+1,r
#define x first
#define y second
#define io std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false)
#define endl '\n'
#define DB(a) ({std::cout << a << ','; hr;})
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;

const int N = 1e6+10;
int n, k, P, fac[N], ifac[N];
int f[N], g[N];
ll qpow(ll a, ll n) {ll r = 1%P; for (a %= P; n; a = a * a % P, n >>= 1) if (n & 1) r = r * a % P; return r;}
ll inv(ll x) {return x <= 1 ? 1 : inv(P%x) * (P - P/x) % P;}

void add(int &a, ll b) {a = (a + b) % P;}

int main() {
	std::cin >> n >> k >> P;
	fac[0] = 1;
	REP(i, 1, N-1) fac[i] = (ll)fac[i-1] * i % P;
	ifac[N-1] = inv(fac[N-1]);
	PER(i, 0, N-2) ifac[i] = (ll)ifac[i+1] * (i+1) % P;
	int ans = qpow(k, n);
	if (n % 2 == 0) {
		f[n] = fac[n];
		REP(z, 1, k) {
			REP(i, 0, n) g[i] = 0;
			for (int i = n; i; i = (i-1)&n) if (f[i]) {
				for (int j = i; 2*j >= i; j = (j-1)&i) {
					add(g[i^j], (ll)f[i] * ifac[j]);
				}
			}
			REP(i, 0, n) swap(f[i], g[i]);
			int res = f[0];
			REP(j, 0, z-1) res = (ll)res * (k-j) % P;
			ans = (ans - res) % P;
		}
	}
	if (ans < 0) ans += P;
	std::cout << ans << std::endl;
}
